title: A proposal ACK can be consumed as the NEWLEADER ACK
cause: The SyncRequestProcessor started at NEWLEADER can write a proposal ACK before the learner thread writes the NEWLEADER ACK; LearnerHandler treats the first ACK after NEWLEADER as the NEWLEADER ACK and waitForNewLeaderAck drops a mismatched zxid without counting the learner.
trigger: Learners DIFF-sync a proposal from a new leader and their learner thread is delayed before writing the NEWLEADER ACK.
consequence: The leader misses its NEWLEADER quorum although every learner acked; activation waited for a learner sync timeout and re-sync (about 22 s versus under 4 s on the old revision).
premises: LearnerHandler consumes the first packet after NEWLEADER as the NEWLEADER ACK.
Learner-side SyncRequestProcessor ACKs share the learner socket and are not ordered after the NEWLEADER ACK.
